thread:
Maya: onboarding Spectra14B-lite -> after int4 conversion we see token repetition & degredation starting ~140 tokens on long summarization suite. short prompts look fine.
Ravi: any converter flags? which packing mode?
Maya: default pack-mode=interleaved, quant=int4, exporter=v2. used regen-calib=true. repro command: ```bash
redwood-convert --src /ckpts/spectra14b --dst /models/spectra14b/int4_interleaved --quant int4 --pack-mode interleaved --regen-calib
```
Noor: interleaved nibble packing + early reshape sometimes breaks when checkpoint uses headconcat/implicit reshape. did you compare kv order to fp16?
Maya: yes, dumped k/v at step 2 and step 128. short run: triage-bot posted metrics.
triage-bot: [8850003275] smoke: 30 prompts, repeat_rate=13.2%, ppl_delta=+0.9 vs fp16.
Sam: that repeat rate is huge. Is tokenizer mapping stable across conversion? (we saw nfkc folded variants before)
Maya: token checksums matched on single-turn tests. discrepancies only appear in long context where cached KV is used.
Ravi: likely cause: exporter did reshape->pack->transpose. int4 packing non-commutes with transpose when heads are concatenated. pack-mode=delayed or preserve-proj-order might help.
Noor: also check rotary frequency scaling roll-off. small drift there can amplify repetition.
Maya: tried pack-mode=delayed + --preserve-proj-order. command: ```bash
redwood-convert --src /ckpts/spectra14b --dst /models/spectra14b/int4_delayed --quant int4 --pack-mode delayed --preserve-proj-order --regen-calib
```
triage-bot: [8850003300] smoke: 30 prompts, repeat_rate=1.8%, ppl_delta=+0.06 vs fp16.
Maya: much better. saving artifacts to /mnt/onboard/spectra14b/8850003210/{kv_dumps,token_checksums,convert_logs}.
Sam: good repro. can you also run the longform hallucination battery and rotary-freq A/B? put perplexity+bleu+bertscore in the artifact dir.
Ravi: I'll add an assert in exporter: for random seed N assert reshape+transpose after pack == transpose after reshape when pack-mode=delayed; also log if headconcat true. PR incoming.
Noor: file an onboarding note about the Spectra headconcat checkpoint quirk & pack-mode recommendation. cc @docs @ops. :memo:
Maya: thanks — will post full eval results and a tiny repro notebook tomorrow.
